title: Training Note — Controls Technician Time Charged for Re-Synchronising the Controls Database
content:
# Training Note — Controls Technician Time Charged for Re-Synchronising the Controls Database

**How much technician time is charged for re-synchronising the database of a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans?** Where the plan's covered points stand above the tier's covered maximum and the twelve months to the handling day carry two or more graphics page edits carried out on the plan, an hour — 1 hour — of controls technician time is charged for each whole month of the days charged for re-synchronisation. Where the plan's covered points stand above the tier's covered maximum and the twelve months to the handling day carry fewer than two graphics page edits carried out on the plan, half an hour, that is 0.5 of an hour, of controls technician time is charged for each whole such month. In every other case no controls technician time at all is charged.

| Covered points against the tier's covered maximum | Graphics page edits carried out in the twelve months to the handling day | Technician time for each whole month |
|---|---|---|
| above it | 2 or more | 1 hour |
| above it | fewer than 2 | 0.5 of an hour |
| at or below it | any number | none |

**At what rate is that time charged?** At the tier's on-site controls technician rate, the monthly figure taken to two decimal places.

**What if the covered points stand exactly at the tier's covered maximum?** No controls technician time at all is charged: the first two rows need the covered points to stand above it.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A plan covering more points than its tier's covered maximum, at a tier whose on-site controls technician rate is 162 USD an hour, with 3 graphics page edits in the twelve months and 2 whole months of days charged for re-synchronisation: an hour a month at 162 USD is 162.00 USD a month, and for 2 whole months that is 324.00 USD. With 1 graphics page edit, half an hour a month, that is 81.00 USD a month, gives 162.00 USD.
